fields: *The elderly round mouse waddles up to Mabel and gives her a big hug*
[pic=5]<slow>Ughhh… </slow>I knew she’d be like this. <pause>She’s so superstitous with bigger critters. One sec.

I can leave, but before I go,
ask her about the storm.
[pic=7]Well, as I thought. <pause>She’s pretty worried about everything…
[pic=10]They’ve noticed the glyphs glowing, and she thinks the storm is foreboading.
[pic=5]I’ve tried to calm her down but she’s convinced herself.
[pic=5]Rascal, I feel like I can’t really ask more of you. <pause>You’ve helped so much already…
[pic=7]Well… <pause>My mom thinks what’s going on isn’t good.
[pic=7]And there’s one thing we can do to quell the spirit of the forest…
[pic=7]I’m trying to remember the ritual she’s talking about… <pause>something like:
[pic=3]"When great travesty is ahead, a bond of the body and soul will prove stronger than any adversity."
[pic=3]Yeaaaah, <pause>the culture here can be… <pause>a bit hedonistic…
[pic=7]But you have to understand, <pause>the life of a mouse is one that can be cut very short.
[pic=3]The pleasures of life is often what we’re chasing, and we hope they somehow fix everything…
[pic=6]But here's the thing. <pause>If something bad is truly happening... <pause>Then there's no other way these mice would like to go down.

Do you think they can still
get it on despite… The context?
[pic=3]Quite the contrary! <pause>The context would actually help them!
[pic=6]Like I said. <pause>If it came down to it, they would wanna go out with a <wave>bang</wave>.
[pic=7]Look, <pause>I wanna believe I’m not superstitious. <pause>I wanna believe that my mom is talking nonsense… <pause>But on the other hand…
[pic=3]I’m worried, <pause>and going through with this couldn’t hurt…
Uh, you had me at orgy.
[pic=4]Gah! I admire your carefree attitude Rascal!

The mice here have a point!
If the worlds ending, might as well
go out with a bang, right?

So what, do I get to join?
Your Mom’s still looking at me…
[pic=7]Well under normal circumstances, <pause>you wouldn’t be able to join…
[pic=6]But since we need your help, <pause>I bet we can make an exception!
[pic=5]<size=10><color=#878375>(Also, as much as I hate to say it, <pause>I think my Mom's been checking you out...)</size></color>
Ok, what do we gotta do?
[pic=3]Well for ceremonies like this, <pause>we usually need to gather a large source of an aphrodisiac.

[pic=3]Well this particular ceremony calls for a uh...
"Seed of great potency."
[pic=6]It is said that the <breath>seed of a wolf</breath> is a potent virility supplement!
[pic=7]There is a wolf that lives nearby… <pause>But he’s not exactly the most cooperative…
[pic=7]I’ve tried talking with him on my own, but eh… <pause>I’m just so small… <pause>he could gulp me up in an instant…
Ok! Well, I can try talking to him.
[pic=7]Something tells me it won’t be that easy… <pause>but if you’d like to help, everyone would certainly appreciate it!
[pic=5]I get anxious with the family sometimes… <pause>I never know how they might react…
[pic=3]I think my mom likes you though, <pause>so that helps.
[pic=5]If you bang my mom. <pause><shake>Please <slow>do not ever</slow> tell me about it.</shake>
[pic=6]Ok. So we need to head East.
[pic=6]The fireflies should help illuminate some new areas. <pause>Let’s give it a shot!
